notes:
**Added**
- Address bar suggestions from your history and bookmarks
- A new tab page that makes no network requests
- Site permissions: Brume asks about camera, microphone and location itself, and remembers your answer
- Site info on the padlock, showing what a site has been allowed
- Bookmark import from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi and Opera
- Bookmark renaming
- Tab search on Ctrl+Shift+A
- Tab muting, from the tab context menu
- Cancelling a running download
- Match case and whole word in find on page
- Ctrl+J for downloads, Ctrl+Shift+Delete for clearing browsing data
- Deleting a single history entry
- Open link in new tab and in private tab, on the page context menu

**Fixed**
- The page loading indicator never appeared
- Opening a new tab or searching while Settings or History was open left the new page hidden behind the panel
- The tab strip lost tabs, and the new tab button, once enough were open
- Tabs restored from the last session all loaded at launch; they now load when clicked, cutting startup memory by about three quarters
